g.text: In Select_s a toggle that falls due waits for Pre-operational; with Ctoggle >= Ntoggle it gives Err_ToggleEnd instead.
In Monitor_s a master heartbeat on the active bus restarts the timer. The when others branch leads to Monitor_s.
